0022600155.text: The Brooklyn Nets (0-5, on a five-game losing streak and 15th in the East) visit the Indiana Pacers (2-4, on a three-game losing streak and 12th in the East) in Brooklyn's sixth game of the season. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise), Mikel Brown Jr. (rest) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain), while Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain) and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), with Aaron Nesmith (hamstring strain) and Obi Toppin (back soreness) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The 2026-27 season series stands at Brooklyn trailing 0-1, following a 136-109 Pacers win in Brooklyn on October 25, and the Nets lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2.
